title: Baba God Dey
summary: Tunde takes a bus full of opinions along three short routes, stops safely and resolves a fare dispute. A striped bag beneath a seat links his ordinary morning to the wedding.

stages.title: One bus. Too many directions.
stages.text:
Passenger One: Your shortcut is longer than the main road.
Tunde: It is a long-term shortcut.
Passenger Two: If we arrive tomorrow, I want yesterday's fare.

Take Baba God Dey through three short road legs. Accelerate, brake and use the marked safe bays. A guided approach is available with the same reward.
stages.summary: Drive three short road legs, read passenger landmarks and stop in the safe bays. Guided controls offer the same progress.

stages.title: Market Road · first safe bay
stages.text:
Passenger: The blue awning, driver. Not the blue argument beside it.

Accelerate along the road, then brake in the lower-lane bay near the end. If you miss it, take the free loop and try again. Guided approach handles pace and the stop for you.
stages.summary: Reach the marked bay in the lower lane and stop. Guided approach is a free, untimed alternative.

choices.label: Take the marked Market Road turn

stages.title: A route needs a reason
stages.text:
Passenger One: There is a shortcut behind the awning.
Passenger Two: That is a shop.
Tunde: Then it has excellent opening hours for a road.

The marked road stays clear. A little patience keeps everyone together.
stages.summary: The shortcut is a shop entrance. Keep to the marked road and leave doorways clear.

choices.label: Try the shop doorway
choices.hint: A doorway is not a road. The marked road rejoins the route without blocking anyone.

stages.title: Crossing ahead · steady now
stages.text:
Tunde: Everybody gets home. Even the argument.

Approach the crossing bay slowly. Come to a stop in the lower lane, then let the pedestrians finish crossing before choosing the next road.
stages.summary: Stop in the lower-lane bay before the crossing. You choose when to continue after it clears.

choices.label: Wait until the crossing is clear
Push through the crossing
choices.hint: The pedestrians still need the road. Stay stopped, let them cross, then continue.

stages.title: The back seat has a committee
stages.text:
Passenger One: I said left.
Passenger Two: I said that you said left incorrectly.
Tunde: A useful distinction. Neither of you is driving.

Ask for one clear landmark before the final leg.
stages.summary: Ask the passengers for a useful landmark. Their argument is not a route instruction.

choices.label: Ask for the blue safe-bay sign
Shout over both passengers
choices.hint: Ask one clear question. The blue safe-bay sign identifies the final stop.

stages.title: Last leg · the blue bay
stages.text:
Passenger: After that sign. A proper stop, please.
Tunde: A proper stop comes with a proper farewell.
Passenger: Does mine include a receipt?

Park in the lower-lane bay and check the seats once everyone is out.
stages.summary: Reach the blue safe bay, brake to a stop and let the passengers leave.

choices.label: Park and let everyone get out

stages.title: No change. Plenty of opinions.
stages.text:
Passenger: I have no change.
Tunde: Yesterday you had no change. Are we preserving a tradition?

Resolve the fare without threatening anyone. This is a story conversation; no StreetCoins are transferred.
stages.summary: Agree a witnessed, recorded fare arrangement. Both calm and firm approaches can work.

choices.label: Agree a recorded fare for the next trip
Ask a witness and agree what is owed
Threaten the passenger
choices.hint: Keep the disagreement nonviolent. Agree a clear record or ask a witness to help.

stages.title: One passenger has no ticket
stages.text:
Under a seat: a striped bag. Its tag carries the Chief's very long name.

Tunde: I carry people. Why is their trouble travelling without a ticket?

Record where you found it and keep the contents intact. A service slip is caught beneath the seat; another passenger may know more later.
stages.summary: Record the unopened bag and its location. Preserve the tag and service-slip lead for later corroboration.

choices.label: Record the bag, tag and seat location
Treat the contents as today's earnings
choices.hint: This is disputed property. Record it intact; it is not a sandbox currency reward.

stages.title: A bag with too many titles
stages.text:
Tunde, calling Ngozi: Do you know a bag with too many titles?
Ngozi: I know a man with too many unpaid invoices.
Tunde: Then I may have found his luggage.
Ngozi: Bring the record. Nobody spends a mystery before lunch.

Baba God Dey complete. Your route choices and bag record are saved.
stages.summary: Tunde resolved the fare dispute and recorded a bag under his bus seat. The wedding tag links it to Ngozi's unpaid catering work. Ajo Day follows.

choices.label: Save the bag record and meet the family
